item.text: The recovery hook currently loads and checks only regular children. The listing API already exposes trash loading and cached trash, and photo links carry an `activeRevision.photo` marker. I’ll use those to include trashed photos and require both caches to finish decrypting before preparation.

The hook now loads both sources, merges regular links with trashed photo links, and checks both caches before success. I’ve added coverage for mixed sources and load and move failures; I’m running the recovery hook tests now.

item.text:
Updated the photo recovery flow in both checked-out copies. It now loads regular and trashed items, waits for both to decrypt, moves trashed photo entries, tracks remaining and failed items, and marks recovery successful only when no targeted photos remain. Load, move, and delete errors mark recovery failed; a persisted in-progress state resumes automatically.

All 12 recovery tests pass in both copies. Lint and formatting pass. The package type check remains blocked by an unrelated OpenPGP type mismatch in `packages/crypto`.
